## Morphology


| Field | Contract / value |
| --- | --- |
| mammal | Muzzle corners, eyelids and ears carry affect; teeth exposure limited by lip anatomy. Lion mane and hare ears are secondary, never replace readable eyes. |
| avian | Brows are feather/upper-eye planes; rigid beak uses jaw hinge and small head changes, not human lip morphs. Owl facial disk and raven/eagle crests stay recognizable. |
| reptile | Use eye aperture, jaw hinge, hood/neck and restrained head tilt; no mammal cheek squash. Turtle neck retraction limited to documented rig range. |
| chitin | Use eye aperture, head plate angle, antennae when present and stinger posture; preserve rigid exoskeleton, no elastic human lips. |
| shark | Use jaw and eye region with restrained soft tissue; avoid projecting mammal lips onto toothed jaw. |
| antlered | Head tilts must preserve antler clearance; no deformation of rigid antlers. |


## Deviations

Every hero has design_proposal.expression_deviation. Additional deviations must retain the ten semantic IDs, context and readable intensity, documented before facial rigging.

## Controls

Intent specification only. Bone/blendshape mapping and range calibration are validated with the first original face in v1.19; no final face rig created.
